The '''''Overlord''''' was a warship in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
A [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnought]], the ''Overlord'' was commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jocend]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The ''Overlord'' was badly damaged during an assault on the Republic border (an attack that was illegal under the terms of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]) and became separated from its escorts. The ship attempted to hide in the upper atmosphere of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] learned of the ''Overlord''{{'s}} presence and sent the elite [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron to capture the ship. The squadron was able to cripple the ''Overlord'' so that the Republic forces could capture the warship and Moff Jocend himself.
